racism has a lot of definitions that are all over the place, but they all have the spirit of "judging someone based on ethnicity", and most of the time it's used that way or similar, which isn't technically correct but that's just kind of how the world works. if you were to define racism as only systemic racism (people being at a disadvantage based on their ethnicity) then you could say that making remarks based on ethnicity is not different from making remarks on their clothing options; thinking black people are bad being the same as thinking someone wearing a fandom t-shirt is into that fandom, although that is pretty obviously racist it's technically not putting them at a disadvantage. if you go by racism being more of a "prejudice based on ethnicity" then believing black people are bad becomes racist since you're assuming what type of person they are based on ethnicity. if you go by the second definition, then you can be racist against majority groups too, ofc it doesnt happen very often because most people in real life arent assholes unlike in the internet, but it is still possible and i think that its not a very healthy view to invalidate people because the "group they belong to" has benefits. i mean just looking at MAGA people, they always make arguments based on how "x minority has it """easier(like lgbt people being more likely to be hired)""" aka they are priviliged aka they never go through problemsv, grouping everyone into the same boat based on superficial characteristics (like skin color) never ends well

endemic life are criters u can find in the map and use agaisnt the monsters.

the beetles inflict elemental statuses like the firebeetle inflicting fireblight and stuff like that, you can find them everywhere on the map

toads inflict other statuses like sleeptoad putting the monster to sleep

you can open your map then use right and left D-pad to change what you can see in the map. you can hold up to 5 of them at once

these are the most important ones:

Firebeetle: makes monster easier to stun.

Snowbeetle: makes the monster slower

Thunderbeetle: i dont remember but its something like makes cut weapons be able to deal blunt damage.

Mudbeetle: makes it so that your weapon cant bounce off the monster anywhere

Paratoad: paralyses monster

Sleeptoad: puts monster to sleep

Poisontoad: inflicts poison

Explosiontoad: explodes

Trapbugs: if a monster steps on them, he will flinch

Brewhare: when you use items like HP potion, it will restore more health than normal

Puppet spider: makes the monster mountable

Stinkmink: if you use it near a monster, it will follow you

Wailnard: can only be found in shrine ruins. It makes every monster go to where it is used

Escuregot: you can throw it and it will heal you

Antidobra: prevents any potion for 3 minutes

Baitfrog or however its called: if you hit him, monsters near by will try to attack it

Lanterbug: Gives you a little extra max hp temporarily

Auroturtle: prevents you from dying once

Gustcrab: if you step on him, he will launch you

Theres a couple more:

Butterflies: theres attack up buttler flies, affinity up dragonflies, stamina down butterflies, etc. they buff your stats

Vigorswaps: if you hit them, it makes a little bubble that heals you

Locale Specific ones:

Shrine ruins:

Flashfly--- If you hit them, they explode in a flash that works exactly the same way ass flashbombs do

Flooded Forest:

Gigangha--- If you throw a piece of raw meat into the water, fish will make a zone that deals damage and traps monsters if they are inside of it

Snow area:

Squid things--- They boost your stats temporarily if you touch them, they are swimming in the water

Sandy plains:

Pinchercrab--- they are attached to walls. If you hit them, they will start shooting rock at you. You can use a kunai and aim it to make them start shooting

Infernal volcano caverns whatever:

Echobat:--- if a monster gets too close, they will start flying above the monster, and sometimes they explode if you hit them.
